sources.summary: Lime-plastered brickwork, timber boards and cork panels were used to help capture the changing light at Pine House, a terraced home in London renovated by local architecture studio Polysmiths. Located in Peckham, the project set out to tackle what Polysmiths founder Charles Wu described as the "well-known limitations" of London's ubiquitous Victorian terraces.
